title: Stabilization of the dimension vectors by the stability parameter: the face structure of a zeta-bullet-stable module
author: Hiraku Nakajima
source_version: Official SIGMA 5 (2009) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2009.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the face lemma on the stabilization of dimension vectors for zeta-bullet-stable modules (author Lemma at source lines 999-1019, label lem:face), and its proof (source lines 1021-1150) is by far the longest of the paper's second section. The argument is organised as a double induction on the rank of a face of the stability parameter and on the dimension vector, with the reduction to the extremal points of the face relying on the author's monotonicity statement for dimension vectors along a wall, which the author attributes to section 5 of the cited paper (proof lines 1021-1150); at the extremal point the module is decomposed into polystable components and each component is matched against the author's earlier criterion for the non-vanishing of the regular part (label thm:Rudakov). The lemma is the technical device on which the author's later description of the strata rests, and its proof is a genuine multi-step induction rather than a citation. H2.
